discourse.excerpt: Sai does not live in structures of stone or brick and mortar! He lives in soft hearts, warm with sympathy and fragrant with universal Love.
discourse.occasion: Installation of Sri Sai Baba idol
discourse.theme: God lives not in stone temples but in soft hearts warm with sympathy and universal love — and peace, our real nature, can be rediscovered in a moment.
discourse.title: Spiritual Academy Of Man

reflection: Swami says God does not live in stone temples but in soft hearts warm with sympathy and universal love — and that peace, our real nature, can be rediscovered in a single moment of silence. Today, keep one minute of real silence before you speak, and let one kind word come from a soft heart. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 2, 2 Dec 1961)
seva_nudge: Offer to help set up or tidy the bhajan hall at Sai Prema Nilayam Riverside this Sunday — or simply sit in quiet company with someone who is lonely.
